{{Alo inversion}}Our Eternal Sibling is an [[epithet]] used to refer to [[Overseer]]. It contrasts with [[Our Greatest Husband|Our Eternal Spouse]] which is for [[Underseer]].

Overseer is a sibling because they are familiar and reinforcing, as a sibling is due to their shared genetics with you and shared upbringing.
